trigger: A known applicable advisory has not been withdrawn.
The metadata provider confirms the checked release is deprecated.
The metadata provider explicitly marks the exact release as retracted.
The provider definitively reports that it does not have the exact release.
A conclusive provider response establishes no unambiguous default for a versionless check.
The age rule requires a publication date and none is available.
The release is younger than the configured minimum age.
The provider reports a publication date after the check time.
A required metadata lookup fails or returns malformed or conflicting release data.
The advisory query did not return a complete result.
The declaration has no unambiguous exact version to check.
The declaration does not identify a supported public package source.
